overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep romantic relationships and husband-wife dynamics (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1764 views, 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1666 views) significantly outperform family bond or generic sad shayari shorts. Standalone sad shayari or direct quotes ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा') have very low traction, proving that narrative-driven relationship questions or realizations perform best.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage love and partner understanding ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') garnered the highest views (1,764 and 1,666 respectively) and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage and long-term relationship pain points, questioning unspoken emotional gaps between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as a direct question about daily relationship realities ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') performed solidly with 382 views.
winning_patterns.action: Use inquisitive, relatable emotional hooks that make the viewer pause and reflect on their own behavior.

weak_patterns.pattern: Pure Sad Shayari / Heavy Poetic Lines
weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' generated only 10 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly poetic or aggressive shayari; ground the content in everyday situational realities instead.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos about sisters or brothers had moderate-to-low views (around 100-200), except for Mother-related content which performed slightly better.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from siblings for now and concentrate heavily on romantic and marital relationships.
